name: Rabenda No Kuki - Chapter 1: Shi No Bijon
source: Our protagonist Kyo is a normal student. He goes to school, does club activities, and also has visions of his friends dying. The game is inspired by the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni series.
translation: 我们的主角京是一名普通学生。他去上学，参加俱乐部活动，还幻想着他的朋友们死去。该游戏的灵感来自于《寒蝉鸣泣之时》系列。
